verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents built-in board, list, calendar, or timeline views, or switching between them for the same work. The only view-related item covers developers creating custom board views through the apps framework. That is a building block for constructing views, not the native multi-view capability the story asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work
